newsitem.title: CANADA: Man dies in central Alberta drilling rig accident.
newsitem.headline: Man dies in central Alberta drilling rig accident.

text.p: A Precision Drilling Corp employee died on Thursday after being struck by equipment at a drilling rig site in central Alberta, Precision said on Friday.

The worker was hit by a part of a tool used to disassemble the drilling string as the rig's crew was pulling drilling tools out of the hole at the site near Rocky Mountain House, Alberta, about 140 km northwest of Calgary.
The Precision rig was contracted by Canadian 88 Energy Corp, Precision vice-president John Jacobsen said.
The employee's name was not being released pending a company and police investigation. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
